title: IRT/RTSM UAT tracker
summary: A user acceptance testing tracker for a synthetic interactive response technology (IRT/RTSM) build: 29 test scripts traced to 30 requirements, a defect log, and a go-live sign-off gate that recomputes as you mark tests, close defects and add a test for the one untraced requirement. The gate packages the evidence for a named tester or biostatistician to sign; it does not grant approval. Operations data only, with no participant data.
try: RAND-04 opens selected: a critical test that failed, with critical defect DEF-01 open. In the Selected test card, mark it Pass and close DEF-01: the counts, the plot and the gate update.
In the go-live gate, click COH-03 and DEF-03 to open the other blockers and fix them, then add a draft test for URS-SUP-005. With all three criteria met, the gate turns READY.
Search the test-script table, or double-click a Status cell in the defect log, type Open or Closed and press Enter.
Download the results as a CSV built in your browser, or Reset to seed to start over.
